subject: Pilot credit hold & multi-sponsor routing
messages:
From: Aria Jacobs <aria@launchfoundry.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@foundryaccelerator.org>
Date: Sun, 7 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot credit hold and routing for multi-sponsor cohort

Hi Sofia —

Quick note from Launch Foundry about our November cohort (cohort #12): a couple of sponsors signed up vouchers that the founders haven't used yet. We ran into a timing mismatch — program kickoff pushed by two weeks — and a handful of vouchers will hit their expiry before teams can realistically consume them.

Ask: can Redwood temporarily place a 45-day hold on voucher expiry and either (A) allow rollover to the next cohort or (B) convert unused voucher value into a short-term reserved capacity credit that the founders can consume once they go into production?

Context:
- ~12 vouchers across four sponsors, total face value ~USD 18k.
- We can provide a CSV of voucher IDs and sponsor contacts (attached).
- Sponsors are open to a short formal amendment if needed — they want to avoid outright refunds.

We realize this is outside the standard terms, but this is a pilot with strong conversion signals. If there is a path (contract amendment, escrow hold, or temporary re-issue) we can get sponsor confirmation quickly.

Would love an initial read and a proposed ops/legal/finance path. Can we set a quick call tomorrow?

Thanks —
Aria Jacobs
Program Manager, Launch Foundry
aria@launchfoundry.com
Attachment: cohort_vouchers_11-04.csv (CSV list of voucher IDs and sponsor emails)
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Aria Jacobs <aria@launchfoundry.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 7 Nov 2027 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot credit hold and routing for multi-sponsor cohort

Hi Aria —

Thanks for the clear note and the CSV — got it. Looping in Ben (sales lead), Laura (finance) and Irene (legal) to triage. Quick summary of the options I see and the tradeoffs so we’re aligned before a call: 

1) 45–60 day expiry hold + rollover to next cohort
   - Least friction for sponsors; preserves voucher face value.
   - Ops: requires a flag in billing to prevent automated expiry and a re-assignment flow for the next cohort.

2) Convert unused vouchers to short-term reserved capacity credits (discounted commit)
   - Useful if teams are likely to go into production; preserves revenue recognition if sponsor agrees to conversion terms.
   - Finance will need a contract amendment and a PO or written sponsor consent.

3) Escrow/hold with later decision (we hold funds and re-issue or refund on sponsor confirmation)
   - More bookkeeping but keeps options open where sponsors are undecided.

Proposed next steps:
- Laura: finance to confirm which option is easiest from an accounting/revenue recognition standpoint and whether we need an amendment template.
- Irene: legal to confirm whether a short template amendment is sufficient or if we need to route through procurement/legal redline.
- Ben: if sponsors require written confirmation, please handle sponsor outreach and capture explicit consent.
- Aria: can you confirm sponsor willingness to sign a one-paragraph amendment allowing either rollover or conversion? If yes, please share the sponsor contact who will sign.

If everyone is OK we can do a 20 minute sync Monday to finalize wording and timeline.

Sofia Ivanova
Customer Success, Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.com
Attachment: sponsor_list.pdf (contact list from Launch Foundry)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Nov 2027 10:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot credit hold and routing for multi-sponsor cohort

Sofia / team —

Finance perspective: we can support a temporary hold up to 60 days with the following caveats:
- We need a sponsor confirmation (email or signed amendment) that they prefer hold/rollover vs refund.
- For any conversion to reserved capacity (committed discount), we need a contract addendum capturing the conversion price and start/end dates for recognition.
- Accounting asks that we mark these as contingent liabilities until sponsor consent is received; that changes close/revenue timing.

Operational asks:
- Ben, please gather sponsor contact + intent (rollover vs conversion) in writing.
- If sponsors choose conversion, we’ll require a PO or signed SOW amendment before enabling dedicated capacity.

Irene — please advise on the minimal amendment language you’d need (one paragraph ideally). If legal is comfortable we can automate a DocuSign flow.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Nov 2027 14:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot credit hold and routing for multi-sponsor cohort

Sofia / team —

Legal is OK with a narrowly scoped exception as long as we have: 
- Written sponsor consent specifying preferred remedy (rollover or conversion).
- A short amendment (1–2 paragraphs) that:
  * Confirms voucher IDs to be held/converted,
  * States the hold period (we suggest 60 days),
  * Defines conversion terms (if chosen): price, start date, and that this amendment supersedes expiry language only for listed vouchers.

I’ve drafted a minimal amendment template and uploaded to our DocuSign sandbox: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC123-amendment-proto (internal link).

Ben — please collect sponsor signoff and route back to legal for execution.

Irene Choi
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com
Attachment: amendment_template.docx (minimal amendment draft)

Thanks, Sofia — and thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. Sponsors confirmed they prefer a 60-day hold with rollover as the first preference and conversion as fallback. Samir and I will collect sponsor signoffs today and expect to return signed emails by EOD.

We’re good to proceed with Irene’s amendment template and the DocuSign link. Can Ben propose a 20-minute sync at 11:30am PT today to finalize? If that works I’ll send a calendar invite with sponsor contacts.

Appreciate it —
Aria
